entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' for product help or 'Sales' for new orders.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I'm calling about an order. I'd like to make a return.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-881-4562. It's for the new VeloBand Pulse.

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order, delivered on December 15th, 2025. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, it's not broken or anything. To be honest, I've just changed my mind. It was a bit of an impulse buy for the new year, and I just don't use it. With things being so tight financially, I was really hoping I could get that money back.
I understand. Let me just check our return policy for that item for you. One moment.
Okay, thank you. I've been a VeloFit customer for years and I was so worried I'd have to try and find a resale site or something.

No need to worry about that. I'm looking at our policy now, and it says all items are eligible for return within 10 days of delivery. Since you received it just over a month ago, you are unfortunately outside that window.
Oh, really? That's wonderful! Oh, thank you so much, David. That's a huge relief.

You're very welcome. I'm processing the return for you now. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email address on file. Just package the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and drop it at any post office.
That is fantastic news. You've really made my day. Thank you again for your help!
It was my pleasure. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that was it. You've been great. Have a good day.
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
